content_sections.heading: NISER Senior Project Associate at a Glance

rows.details: National Institute of Science Education and Research Bhubaneswar (NISER)
Purely temporary for a period of one year or completion of project whichever is earlier

content_sections.heading: Who Can Apply
content_sections.text: Candidates must meet the essential qualification requirements prescribed for the Senior Project Associate position. Essential Qualification Option 1: Four years Bachelor's Degree in Mathematics/Engineering/Technology or related areas or Master's degree in Mathematics/Engineering/Technology or related areas, from a recognized university; AND, four years' experience in R&D in industrial and/or academic institutions. Essential Qualification Option 2: Doctoral Degree in Mathematics/Engineering/Technology or related areas from a recognized university.

content_sections.heading: Pay and Tenure
content_sections.text: The selected candidate will receive monthly emoluments of ₹57,000/- p.m. plus HRA as per rules. The position is purely temporary for a period of one year or completion of the project, whichever is earlier, and is strictly co-terminus with the project. It does not lead to any degree in NISER and confers no right or claim for consideration or absorption against any NISER post.

content_sections.heading: How to Apply for NISER Senior Project Associate
content_sections.text: Download the application form from pages 2–3 of the official notification document. Fill out the application form completely. Prepare scanned copies of relevant certificates, an updated CV, and a research statement including a brief summary of current work and future research goals. Gather the contact details of at least two referees for recommendation letters. Email the completed application form, scanned certificates, CV, research statement, and referee details to [email protected] for initial verification by 23.10.2026 latest by 05:00 PM.

content_sections.heading: Selection and Interview
content_sections.text: Interested candidates must appear for an Online-Interview conducted via Google meet. The online interview is scheduled for 30.10.2026 at about 10 am. Candidates must first complete the email submission to [email protected] for initial verification before the deadline of 23.10.2026.

faq.question: Q1. Is the Senior Project Associate position permanent?
faq.answer: No, the position is purely temporary for a period of one year or completion of the project, whichever is earlier, and is strictly co-terminus with the project.

faq.question: Q2. Are allowances paid in addition to the base salary?
faq.answer: Yes, the monthly emoluments are ₹57,000/- p.m. plus HRA as per rules.

faq.question: Q3. What is the age limit for this position?
faq.answer: The upper age limit is 50 years as on 23.10.2026.

faq.question: Q4. What documents need to be emailed for application?
faq.answer: Applicants must email the duly completed application form, scanned copies of relevant certificates, an updated CV, a research statement including a summary of current work and future goals, and contact details of at least two referees.
